SANJAY SHARMA
Graphic Designer | Motion Designer | Video Editor | Videographer | Content Strategist

Motion Graphic Designer & Creative Strategist with 6+ years of experience delivering performance-driven 
design & video communication. Worked with 50+ brands including LG Electronics India, Myntra helping 

improve CTR, conversions & audience engagement across digital platforms. Strong at merging storytelling 
with business goals to create measurable results. Skilled in leveraging AI-driven creative workflows to deliver 

faster, smarter & more impactful campaigns.

Delivered 200+ product and DIY informational videos for LG Electronics India, improving product understanding and 
communication outcomes.

Created 500+ performance-driven digital ad creatives for Hippo Homes (Dalmia Bharat Group), supporting its growth 
from 1 to 4 stores.

Produced 200+ campaigns for Remote Resource, contributing to increased lead generation and customer acquisition.

Improved campaign results with 20 to 30% higher CTR, 15 to 35% better conversions, 10 to 50% revenue uplift and 
20 to 40% reduced ad fatigue for multiple clients.

Designed and edited over 5,000 videos and 4,000 static creatives, improving brand visibility and audience retention.

Campaign creatives featured on TV and print media, increasing brand trust and visibility at a national level.

Worked with more than 50 brands across multiple industries delivering results-focused visual communication.

SOFTWARE & TOOLS

• Animation

Pause here. Because what I bring isn’t common.
I convert ideas into results — using design, motion, content and strategy together.
Have delivered growth to 50+ brands across industries. 
Hiring me means one person replacing multiple creative roles — 
designer, editor, animator, videographer and strategist — all aligned to business outcomes.
I know how audiences think, what stops their scroll, and what makes them act.
If I could convince you to pause and read this, imagine what I can make your audience do.



WORK EXPERIENCE
11/2024 – Present
Noida

08/2020 – 02/2022 
Noida

Applied various art forms, including typography, videography, graphic design, and photogra-
phy, to translate original ideas into visual storytelling for early-stage sales pitches and client 
proposals.

02/2022 – 04/2023 
Delhi

04/2023 – 11/2024 
Noida

Marvy Group (Client-LG Electronic India) - Creative Producer (Motion & Visual 
Design)
Product Video Production: Shoot, edit, & produce high-quality product videos to enhance brand 
presence.
Worked with LG Electronics India during its IPO phase, contributing to brand-aligned visual 
projects and internal communications.
DIY Informational Videos: Plan, script, shoot, direct, and provide voiceovers for engaging DIY and 
instructional content.
End-to-End Content Creation: Oversee the entire content production process from ideation to 
execution, ensuring high-quality visual storytelling.

Remote Resource - Motion & Graphics Designer

Maintained awareness of current industry and technology standards, social media, competi-
tive landscape, and market trends.
Ensured all produced material is correctly optimized for chosen dissemination (web, social 
media, large presentation screen, social media).
Managed multiple clients and created over 200+ static and video ads for company services, which 
helped the company acquire more clients.

Hippo Homes(Dalmia Bharat Group) - Motion & Graphics Designer

Aligned with top management to roll out key campaigns on service excellence and engage-
ment, participated in the new store launch, and created over 500+ Google ads.
Creating some eye-catching designs like, Promotional offers, New schemes and weekly 
offers, Study creative ideas and develop videos whether they are Testimonials videos, opener 
videos, store guest welcome Videos, store product category videos, store tour videos, & New offer 
and scheme videos. 
Managed multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines were met and delivera-bles 
were of high quality.

New Vision Digital - Team Lead: Motion Graphics Designer

Provided creative direction and guidance to the design team, ensuring all visual content 
aligned with the brand's vision and goals.
Worked with over 50+ different clients worldwide across various business niches.

2021 Bachelor of Commerce from Delhi University, New Delhi, India

2019
Graphics Design, Animation, Video Editing and Web Design 
Oxford Software Institute, Delhi, India
Certifications

EDUCATION

2022 Linkedin Learning

Practical Creativity for Everyone, Graphics Design Techniques
